evidence.title: Digital Edge and B.Grimm Power Break Ground on First EEC Data Center, Advancing Thailand’s AI and Cloud Infrastructure Ambitions
evidence.excerpt: Digital Edge reports the official start of construction for its and B.Grimm Power’s first joint data center in Thailand, a flagship campus in Chonburi’s Eastern Economic Corridor, and forecasts ready for service in Q4 2026.

metadata.reported_construction_wording: official start of construction for the flagship 100-megawatt (MW) campus
metadata.status_scope: The dated official disclosure expressly marks the start of construction. It supports one generic under_construction observation as of September 4, 2025 only; it does not establish site-preparation, clearing, civil-works, excavation, foundations, shell, MEP, energization, commissioning, completion, ready-for-service, occupancy, operation, or current-load status, nor prove that construction remained unchanged at retrieval.
metadata.reported_locality: Chonburi, within Thailand’s Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC)
metadata.locality_guardrail: The title, introduction, project description, and executive quotations identify the site in Chonburi within the Eastern Economic Corridor. One later body sentence calls it the ‘Bangkok campus’; that internally inconsistent publisher wording creates no Bangkok identity, merge, address, coordinate, or geometry and does not override the repeated Chonburi/EEC locality. No street address, parcel, point, footprint, satellite placement, or unique-site geocode is created.
metadata.capacity_guardrail: The 100 MW campus figure is not typed as critical IT, gross facility demand, grid connection, utility allocation, generation nameplate, current load, annual energy, or measured consumption. It remains raw metadata and creates no capacity row, conversion, phase allocation, or arithmetic.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: The Q4 2026 ready-for-service window is forward-looking and has no exact source date. It creates no target_date, commissioning, completion, energization, operational, occupancy, utilization, or current-load observation.
metadata.investment_scope: The approximately US$1 billion statement is a five-year Digital Edge and B.Grimm Power investment plan for a portfolio of data centers in Thailand. It is not a site-specific project cost, campus valuation, financing close, capacity, energy, or construction-progress measurement.
metadata.operating_model_scope: The source says the facility will offer high-density colocation once completed. This supports one future-project colocation observation only; it does not establish service availability, occupancy, an operating tenant, customer identity, current use, or operation.
metadata.classification_guardrail: AI-ready, future-proof, AI infrastructure, cloud provider, hyperscale, liquid-cooling, high-density, and future AI and cloud demand language describes design capability, intended market, and future services only. It creates no normalized workload, installed hardware, rack density, tenant, customer, user, utilization, model, or present compute observation.
metadata.role_scope: The source describes the facility as the partners’ first joint data center, says it is being developed under their joint venture, and describes Digital Edge and B.Grimm Power as delivering it together. This supports developer roles for Digital Edge and B.Grimm Power only; it creates no owner, operator, landlord, tenant, user, customer, utility, contractor, investor, or power-supplier role.
metadata.energy_guardrail: B.Grimm Power’s energy business and sustainability language do not identify a project utility, power agreement, generation asset, energy source, renewable fraction, gross demand, grid capacity, annual energy, measured consumption, PUE, WUE, current draw, or current emissions observation. No energy or PUE row is created.
metadata.entity_model_guardrail: The campus entity is an internal parent container for the single current-development project at one physical site. It is not a second data center, facility, building, phase, project, construction start, or site count and must never be added to the child project when counting physical sites or developments.
metadata.collision_guardrail: This Chonburi EEC site is not merged with Digital Edge facilities in Bangkok, other Thai projects, the Digital Edge CGK campus in Indonesia, B.Grimm Power assets, or any unique parcel.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: Publisher photographs, renderings, satellite imagery, aerial imagery, computer vision, and analyst geolocation contribute nothing to identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, classification, roles, coordinates, geometry, physical-site count, or construction-stage precision.
